name: abl-lsp
description: OpenEdge ABL outline, go-to-definition, hover, completion, preprocessor, built-in docs, formatting, lint and class checks.
author: Connor Van Etten

abl.propath.markdownDescription: PROPATH used to resolve include files, `RUN` targets and classes. An array of folders or a `;`-separated string. Relative entries are resolved against the first workspace folder. Empty means the workspace folders.

abl.schema.markdownDescription: Database schema dumps (`.df` files) used for table and field navigation, hover and completion. The file name is the logical database name (`sports2000.df` → `sports2000.customer`). Empty means every `.df` file in the workspace.

abl.preprocessor.markdownDescription: Preprocessor names defined before every file, as if by `&GLOBAL-DEFINE`, for example compile-time flags: `{ "MY-FLAG": "yes" }`. Used for `&IF DEFINED(...)` and `{&NAME}`.

abl.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription: Keyword case applied by Format Document. `preserve` leaves keywords as written.

abl.lint.markdownDescription: Lint rules and their level: `off`, `hint`, `info`, `warning` or `error`. Suppress one finding with `/* lint-ignore */` or `/* lint-ignore rule-name */` on the same line or the line above.

unused-parameter.description: A parameter that is never used in its procedure, function or method. Skipped for OVERRIDE and interface methods, EXTERNAL procedures and prototypes.

unused-variable.description: A variable that is never used. Skipped for SHARED variables, CATCH variables, non-private class members and include files.

missing-no-undo.description: DEFINE VARIABLE / PARAMETER / TEMP-TABLE / PROPERTY without NO-UNDO. Quick fix: Add NO-UNDO.

find-without-no-error.description: FIND without NO-ERROR (FIND CURRENT is skipped). Quick fix: Add NO-ERROR.

unused-buffer.description: A DEFINE BUFFER that is never used. Skipped for SHARED buffers, non-private class members and include files.

for-each-without-lock.description: FOR EACH/FIRST/LAST on a database table without NO-LOCK, SHARE-LOCK or EXCLUSIVE-LOCK (defaults to SHARE-LOCK). Temp-tables are skipped. Quick fix: Add NO-LOCK.

find-without-lock.description: FIND on a database table without a lock option (defaults to SHARE-LOCK). Temp-tables and FIND CURRENT are skipped. Quick fix: Add NO-LOCK.

keyword-abbreviation.description: Abbreviated keywords (DEF VAR, DISP, AS CHAR). Quick fix: expand to the full keyword, keeping your case.

missing-implementation.description: A concrete class that does not implement every interface method/property/event or inherited ABSTRACT member. Skipped when a supertype cannot be found.

missing-override.description: A method with the same name and parameter count as a superclass method, without OVERRIDE. Quick fix: Add OVERRIDE.

override-without-base.description: A method marked OVERRIDE when no superclass has a method with that name and parameter count.

abl.diagnostics.unresolvedIncludes.description: Warn when an include file cannot be found on the PROPATH.

abl.serverPath.description: Path to a custom abl-lsp executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

abl.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the 'ABL Language Server' output channel.
